title: Formal Written Spanish
goal: Recognise and write the formal Spanish of notices, rules and official letters: Todo aquel que desee participar deberá…
grammar: Formal register: notices, rules and letters

items: I can read and write short notices with todo aquel que, cualquier persona que and se ruega.
I can tell formal Spanish from everyday Spanish.
I can use the new words for notices and letters.
